title: Veterans Day Celebration & Chili Cook-off
description: Mark your calendars for November 8th! Join us as we honor and celebrate the men and women who have faithfully served our country. As part of our Veterans Day celebration, we will be hosting a Chili Cook-off following the service! Bring your favorite chili recipe and compete for bragging rights, or simply come ready to taste and enjoy a great time of fellowship. Sign up sheet in the back. Everyone is welcome to participate and celebrate with us as we show our gratitude to our veterans.
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
